description: Low-latency desktop and game streaming between your own computers over Tailscale.
notes: Latch is installed to $env:LOCALAPPDATA\Latch, with Start Menu and Desktop shortcuts and an entry in Settings > Apps.
Open Latch Host and click 'Set up as administrator' on the Sharing tab to share this PC.
Latch updates itself. 'scoop update' installs a release only when it is newer than the copy in $env:LOCALAPPDATA\Latch.
'scoop uninstall' leaves that copy in place. To remove it, use Latch's entry in Settings > Apps.
post_install: Write-Host "Latch $have in $installed is newer than $version; it was left in place."
# install-host.ps1 up to 6.0.0 stops if the profile has no Run key.
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "install-host.ps1 failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
